data.body: Follow-up debug report for the operator-approved unified-force revision. The proven adapter-boundary RCA remains unchanged; merged dependency blusterous-earthly-kitten established the corrected contract. RED: the revised live FastMCP oracle rejected nonempty and empty string forces as invalid booleans and found the stale separate reason field. GREEN: transition_ticket now exposes force: str | None = None, forwards force=force, and uses that one value for both start-work and completion-close bypasses; only None is absent and an empty string records the shared (no reason given) placeholder. The separate MCP reason field/test and obsolete force-close surface assertions are removed; caused_by/ref behavior remains intact. The live schema pins transition force byte-equivalent to claim force. Mutation proof: replacing the delegate with force=None made all four nonempty/empty transition cases RED while both None controls retained absent semantics; restoring force=force returned the suite GREEN. Focused schema/start-work/completion/caused_by/ref oracle: 9 passed. Broader MCP surface, force-unification, output-schema, and generated-reference suites passed; make lint, make typecheck, complexity (active=51 new=0 increased=0 stale=0), generated MCP reference --check, DCO, and trailer verification passed. No new dependency, no weakened test, no unrelated sibling found in the bounded MCP docs/generator/test reference sweep. Amended WIP patchset c78010132d510dd687eb60bbdbb4a13eae4eddbc pushed to Gerrit 1871 with Change-Id I2570cc60f55e69665ca45fc52296021d5738bb05 retained. Gerrit invalidated the prior LLM-Review+1 and Verified+1 votes for the new patchset; the change remains WIP and was not submitted.
